parameters.name: PortRangeListId
parameters.description:
The port list ID.

>If the port list is associated with other resources, it cannot be deleted. Dissociate the port list from the resources before you delete it.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the port list. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
